subject: maths
question: A train of length 360 meters crosses an electric pole in 30 seconds and crosses another train of the same length traveling in the opposite direction in 15 seconds. What is the speed of the second train?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Speed** of the first train (S₁) = 360 ÷ 30 = 12 m/s.

**Relative Speed** in **opposite direction** = (360 + 360) ÷ 15 = 720 ÷ 15 = 48 m/s.

Speed of the **second train** (S₂) = Relative Speed − S₁ = 48 − 12 = 36 m/s.

**∴ The correct answer is 36 m/s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Length** of Train 1 (L₁) = 360 m

**Time** to cross **electric pole** = 30 sec

**Length** of Train 2 (L₂) = 360 m

**Time** to cross each other in **opposite direction** = 15 sec

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/218b1cfa403d7c31ee3d4c440799805d2711881a1bd90e77bdb2e158a6d1ae39.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Relative Speed (Opposite) = S₁ + S₂

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed of Train 1 (S₁) = L₁ ÷ Time to cross pole

⇒ S₁ = 360 ÷ 30 = 12 m/s

⇒ Total Distance while crossing each other = L₁ + L₂ = 360 + 360 = 720 m

⇒ Relative Speed = Total Distance ÷ Time to cross each other

⇒ S₁ + S₂ = 720 ÷ 15

⇒ 12 + S₂ = 48

⇒ S₂ = 48 − 12 = 36 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 36 m/s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concepts

When moving in the **opposite direction**, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂. When moving in the **same direction**, Relative Speed = |S₁ − S₂|.

Crossing Distance

The distance covered to cross a **stationary point** (pole, person) is the **train length**. To cross another **object with length** (train, bridge), the distance is (L₁ + L₂).

Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.</p
